subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – order confirmation email
body_text:
Hi Neha,

Thank you for your time on our call. You had connected your payment gateway, but your customers were not getting the order confirmation email after they buy.

What we resolved:
- Following our guidance, you switched on the order confirmation email for your product and saved it, and a test order you placed produced the confirmation email in your inbox.

What we covered:
- The default sender name on the email can be changed under Email settings, Sender name. This is not yet done.

Your next steps:
1. Change the sender name to your brand name under Email settings, Sender name (you mentioned after the call).

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-01

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Riya
FlexiFunnels Support
